疼痛顺着她的血脉传入了她的大脑，使她整个人瞬间清醒了过来。她虽和韩经年接触的不多，但是她也不是不经人事的小姑娘，所以她很快就弄明白了她身上的重量是怎么一回事。是韩经年……他不是走了吗？难道他一直没走？可他不是说只是回来拿文件的吗？疑惑如同潮水般，瞬间淹没了夏晚安的大脑。只是她还没想透彻，她就被腰间肌肤上传来的疼痛，再次打断了思绪。今天的他，和以往的他差别太大了……以往的他，尽管也是这样冷清的模样，和她一句话也不说，但那时的他，虽谈不上多怜香惜玉，但除了第一次外，也没让她疼的难以忍受，可今天的他，也不知是怎么了，下手的力道很重，就连动作也粗鲁的像是个会吞噬人的野兽……他让她真的很疼，比第一次的时候还要疼……她记得第一次，她疼的险些落了泪，她开口提醒他后，他力道收敛了许多，夏晚安在疼的真的忍不下去后，抖着声音开了口，说了和第一次时一模一样的话：“那个……疼……”这三个字，是他和她结婚后的半年里，他们交谈的仅有的唯一的话。夏晚安不知怎么，心底蓦的一阵酸楚，她本以为和第一次一样，她说了这样的话，他会温柔些，可她没想到，她错了，他不但没温柔，反而更变本加厉了，她总觉得他是在生气，在惩罚，可她却又想不通，他为何生气，她又没招惹她……他没半点缓和的意思，她受不了的开始挣扎，这大概是她和他结婚以来第一次她有抗拒的动作，他明显的愣了愣，然后她就又被他死死地按在了身下，她力道哪里抵得过他，天生男女体力的差别，让她就像是被放在案板上被待宰杀的鱼一般，根本无济于补。怎么结束的，她不清楚，她只知道，第二天她醒来，她本能的往旁边看了一眼，另半张床很整洁。他又一次已经走掉了，而且还是在昨晚结束后，他都没在家睡，就直接走掉了。夏晚安盯着空荡荡的半张床愣怔了一会儿，然后才坐起身想要起床。她这样一动，才发现自己的身体仿佛散了架一样，到处都酸痛无比，好在今天是周末，她也没什么别的事忙碌，随便搞了点吃的，填饱肚子后，就继续去睡觉了。下午醒来，夏晚安觉得身体舒服了许多，周末是她去超市采购一周食物的时间，所以她简单的收拾了一下自己，就出了门。她一个人也吃不了多少东西，但随便买买，也拎了两个大袋子回家。和她一同进电梯的是位中年女人，大概看她两只手都拎着东西很辛苦，热情的问：“姑娘，你住在几楼？”夏晚安道了句“谢谢”后，报了自己所住的楼层数。这是高档公寓，一层一户，很保护隐私，但中年女人在听到夏晚安的楼层数后，一边帮她按楼层数，一边诧异的看了她好几眼：“你去27楼？”

The pain spread through her blood vessels into her brain, causing her to wake up instantly. Although she didn't have much contact with Han Jingnian, she was not an indifferent little girl, so she quickly figured out what the weight on her body was about. It's Han Jingnian... isn't he gone? Did he never leave? But didn’t he say he was just coming back to get documents? Doubts were like a tide, instantly flooding Xia Wan'an's brain. But before she could think through it, her thoughts were interrupted again by the pain coming from the skin of her waist. The difference between him today and him in the past is so big... In the past, although he looked so cold and didn't say a word to her, at that time, although he was not very affectionate, he did not cause her unbearable pain except for the first time. But today, he didn't know what was wrong. He struck hard and even his movements were as rough as a beast that could devour people... He made her really It hurt a lot, even more painful than the first time... She remembered the first time, it hurt so much that she almost shed tears. After she reminded him, he restrained his strength a lot. After Xia Wan'an really couldn't bear the pain anymore, he opened his mouth with a trembling voice and said exactly the same words as the first time: "That... hurt..." These three words were the only words they had talked about in the six months since they got married. Xia Wan'an felt a sudden sadness in her heart for some reason. She thought it was the same as the first time. She said such words and he would be gentler, but she didn't expect that she was wrong. Instead of being gentle, he became even more serious. She always felt that he was angry and punishing, but she couldn't figure out why he was angry and she didn't provoke her... He didn't do anything. It meant to ease. She couldn't bear it and started to struggle. This was probably the first time she had resisted since she got married to him. He was obviously stunned, and then she was pinned down by him again. Her strength could not match him. The natural difference in physical strength between men and women made her like a fish being put on the chopping board to be slaughtered, which was of no help at all. She didn't know how it ended. She only knew that when she woke up the next day, she instinctively glanced to the side. The other half of the bed was very neat. Once again, he had left, and it was after last night that he didn't even sleep at home, so he left directly. Xia Wan'an stared at the empty half-bed for a while, then sat up and wanted to get up. When she moved like this, she realized that her body seemed to be falling apart, and she was extremely sore everywhere. Fortunately, it was the weekend, and she had nothing else to do. She grabbed some food, filled her stomach, and then went to sleep. When she woke up in the afternoon, Xia Wan'an felt much better. The weekend was when she went to the supermarket to buy food for the week, so she simply packed herself up and went out. She couldn't eat much by herself, but she bought whatever she wanted and carried two big bags home. The person who entered the elevator with her was a middle-aged woman. She probably saw that it was hard for her to carry things with both hands, so she asked enthusiastically: "Girl, which floor do you live on?" After Xia Wan'an said "thank you", she reported the number of the floor she lived on. This is a high-end apartment with one floor per unit, which protects privacy. But after the middle-aged woman heard Xia Good Night's floor number, she counted the floors for her and looked at her several times in surprise: "Are you going to the 27th floor?"
